title: cajeta deps --format=json
description: Output of `cajeta deps --format=json`. The root is the project; `dependencies` on the root is the direct-dependency list. Every node has the same shape. See specs/dependency-tree-spec.md section 5.2.

manifest.description: Absolute path of the manifest that was resolved.

dependencies.description: The direct dependencies, sorted by name.

cycles.description: Each cycle as the path that closes it; the first and last names are equal. Empty when the graph is acyclic.

version.description: Resolved version. One per name: MVS picks a single version for every package.

requested.description: The constraint this node's parent declared, verbatim.

repository.description: Name of the repository that supplied the artifact.

status.description: Present only when `dependencies` is not the complete child list. repeated: the subtree was printed under an earlier parent. cycle: this edge closes a cycle and was not followed. opaque: the package has no manifest sidecar, so its children are unknown. truncated: cut by --depth.
